title: pm-dispatch references: platform-facts sweep — five measured deliverables across four member cards
body:
Filed by the skills seat (session `session_018WuTtyckQa1VcXwgd52JpN`) under this shift's maintainer grant (2026-08-13, verbatim, untranslated: 「集中处理skills车道中的所有任务，包括分诊和集中开卡你都可以处理。」). Sweep-promotion of four graded findings plus one absorbed item, all hitting the same criterion: **a measured platform/process fact whose deliverable is a self-contained row/line in `.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/**`** — no SKILL.md lines, no code. Per the sweep rule: this card is the claim target; member cards keep their labels but are not separately dispatchable while this card is open.

## Members and itemized deliverables (落点 | content)

1. **#8434** — `references/review-checklist.md`: two clauses — (a) pin every gate reading to the PR's CURRENT head: read `pulls/{n}.head.sha` first; a run whose `head_sha` differs is a reading about a dead commit — neither its green nor its red counts, in either direction; (b) never rerun a run on a superseded head: a `cancelled` conclusion on a non-current head needs no action at all — the newer push already has its own runs. Plus one `references/platform-readings.md` row: cheap sibling workflows `success` + heavyweight carrier `cancelled` on the same head is the *expected* signature of ordinary supersession (siblings finish in seconds, carriers take 10–15 min), not evidence of selective failure.
2. **#8374** — `references/platform-readings.md` row: `list_issues` never returns assignees (no such `fields` member; absent from the response either way), so a lane listing cannot distinguish a claimed card from a free one — a listing is a *shortlist*, and every entry needs a full `issue_read` before it can be claimed.
3. **#8272** — `references/platform-readings.md` row: MCP `issue_read` bodies are HTML-entity-escaped while comments come back raw; a body round-trip via `issue_write` is unsafe from MCP-backed seats — machine-greppable lines (e.g. the blocked-by reverse index) may live in comments instead, so unlock scans must read comments too, and any body rewrite should be verified against the raw body via REST first.
4. **#8187** — `references/dispatch-runbook.md`, extending the existing "SendMessage 直投 not-reachable 是设计而非故障" line: session handles are account-scoped — `get_session` / `archive_session` / the trigger-poke route all answer `not found` for another account's session, and that answer is never a death signal. Plus `references/seat-post-protocol.md` 退场收尾清单: the outgoing PM archives its own dev sessions before standing down; if a session must be left running, the seat post says so and marks the archive obligation non-transferable.
5. **#8294 item 3 only** — `references/platform-readings.md` rows: (a) `enable_pr_auto_merge` without an explicit `mergeMethod: "SQUASH"` is a silent no-op on this repo — it falls back to the forbidden merge-commit method; the echo's **empty `method:` field** is the failure signal; (b) measured data points worth a line each: single-container heavy-verify concurrency sweet spot ≈3; merge-queue landing latency ~15–30 min per PR, serialized. Items 1–2 of #8294 are absorbed elsewhere (the os-dev role-file card) — ⛔ **this PR must NOT close #8294**; reference it in prose only, never in a closing position, and do not create a development link to it.

## Constraints

- File surface: `.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/**` ONLY. ⛔ No SKILL.md edits (line ratchet untouched). Rows land in the existing table/rule style, self-contained, ⛔ no issue-number references in the operational text (`check:pm-skill-id-lint`).
- Serial: `references/dispatch-runbook.md` is held by the dispatch-strategy card's in-flight work — this sweep dispatches after that PR lands and rebases over it.
- Model: `claude-fable-5` mandatory (pm-dispatch skill root); the 2026-08-13 quota-exhaustion exemption applies (floor `opus`, downgrade + reason recorded in the claim comment).
- Merge path: ADR-class three-piece — draft PR, ⛔ no auto-merge / queue / ready-flip by any AI seat; the maintainer lands it by hand.
- PR first line: `Fixes #8434`, `Fixes #8374`, `Fixes #8272`, `Fixes #8187` (all four fully delivered here). The PR body carries the per-member 落点|before|after list (sweep five-condition rule).
